title: Cell encoding under one step
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $x$ be a finite Boolean string, and let $s$ be a natural number. Suppose configuration $C$ has all work-tape heads within distance $s$ of the origin and blank work-tape cells outside that window. For any one-step action $a$, any natural number $j<2s+1$, and the updated head-and-output summary determined by $a$ and $C$, the encoded cell at position $j$ of the configuration after applying $a$ equals the local update of the encoded cell at $j$ and its two neighboring cells, using an empty cell beyond either endpoint of the window.

$C$ has all work-tape heads within distance $s$ of the origin
